selection.ownership: beehiiv, founded 2021 in New York, NY, United States. Global newsletter API at api.beehiiv.com.

research.searchCoverage: Official Beehiiv API v2 (GET /v2/publications, GET /v2/publications/{publicationId}, GET /v2/publications/{publicationId}/posts, GET /v2/publications/{publicationId}/posts/{postId}) with Authorization Bearer API keys (OAuth also exists but is not required), New York identity, and dated incident search (beehiiv newsletter security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying current unresolved beehiiv API/customer-data compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official API is HTTPS https://api.beehiiv.com/v2 with Bearer API keys created under Settings > Integrations > API. Operator is beehiiv in New York. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying unresolved beehiiv compromise. OAuth exists but is not required.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to official GET /publications?limit=1, matching the pinned credential validator.

expand[] array query appends are omitted.

Maps to official GET /publications. Optional limit (1-100), page, direction, and orderBy (order_by). expand[] is omitted because native query templates cannot express repeated expand without unused inputs.
publicationId is a required path parameter on GET /publications/{publicationId}. expand[] is omitted.

Maps to official GET /publications/{publicationId}/posts. Optional audience, platform, status, limit, page, orderBy (order_by), direction, and hiddenFromFeed (hidden_from_feed). expand[] and other array filters are omitted.
publicationId and postId are required path parameters on GET /publications/{publicationId}/posts/{postId}. expand[] and premium_tiers array query are omitted.
